scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.start:render: npx prisma db push --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss && node apps/api/dist/index.js
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev --workspace=@afreen-mall/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@afreen-mall/web" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run desktop:compile && electron dist-electron/main.js"
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build && npm run desktop:compile && electron-builder --dir
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run desktop:compile && electron-builder --win
